run-in-terminal: Paste into the pointer terminal, then press Enter to run
placeholder: How can pointer help you today?
resize-composer: Drag to resize — double-click to reset
chat-disabled-no-provider: Set up a chat provider first.
workspace-context-unavailable: no index to search yet — build one in the embeddings tab
workspace-context-empty-hint: Nothing was added to the prompt. Lower the reranker threshold in the embeddings tab to let weaker matches through, or re-index if the code has changed.
workspace-context-score: Reranker score {{score}}: how likely this chunk answers the question
workspace-context-imports-title: The file's imports, added so the names in the hit above resolve
apply-code: Apply to the editor as a diff you can accept or reject
agent-settings-edits-apply-title: Changes are applied and saved straight away; each reply lists them so you can undo them.
agent-settings-edits-review-title: Each change waits in the editor as a diff to accept or reject, and the agent stops until you answer.
agent-settings-commands-ask-title: Each command waits for your Run, apart from those you chose Always run for.
agent-settings-commands-run-title: Every command runs without asking (the auto-run switch).
agent-settings-commands-off-title: The agent cannot run commands. Reading git history still works.
agent-settings-run-in-background-title: A process of its own, its output in the step; stopped after two minutes.
agent-settings-run-in-terminal-title: The pointer tools terminal, where you can watch it and type.
agent-settings-steps-title_one: At most {{count}} tool step in one reply
agent-settings-steps-title_other: At most {{count}} tool steps in one reply
agent-settings-forget-title: Forget the commands and MCP tools you chose Always run for; each asks again.
agent-settings-mcp-title: Servers in pointer.chatToolsMcpServers whose tools agent mode can use. Their calls ask first unless you chose Always run for the tool.
changes-undo-title: Put {{path}} back as it was before this reply
changes-undo-all-title: Put every file back as it was before this reply. Outside a git repository, files changed by commands the agent ran are not included.
changes-no-undo-title: Binary or too large to keep a copy of, so it cannot be undone from here.
changes-open-title: Compare {{path}} with what it was before this reply
reply-instructions-title: Agent mode followed the project's instructions in {{files}}. Click to open.
reply-withheld-title: Replaced with placeholders before this request left your machine: {{kinds}}. The model never saw the values; they are shown again wherever the reply uses them.
reply-continue-title: Ask the model to carry on where this reply stopped
reply-continue-steps-title: The agent used all its tool steps for this reply. Let it carry on from where it got to.
insert-at-cursor: Insert at the cursor in the editor, replacing any selection
queued-steer-title: The agent reads this at its next step. If it finishes first, this goes as your next message.
queued-title: Messages waiting for the current reply
agent-mode-on-title: Agent mode is on: the model can read, search and edit files and run commands in this workspace. Click or Shift+Tab to turn it off.
agent-mode-off-title: Agent mode is off: the model only answers. Click or Shift+Tab to let it work in the workspace.
tool-always-run-mcp-title: Call it, and call {{tool}} again without asking, whatever its arguments. "ask again" in the agent settings clears the list.
tool-always-run-title: Run this command, and run this exact command again without asking whenever the model wants it. "Pointer - Forget commands set to always run" clears the list.
tool-command-keys: enter run · shift+enter always · esc skip
tool-command-to-terminal-title: Put the command in your terminal, to look at or run again; nothing runs until you press Enter
tool-command-keys-ask: enter run · esc skip · your team asks before every command
tool-stop-title: Stop this command. The model gets what it printed so far and carries on.
auto-run-on-title: Every command runs without asking. Click to have each one shown with Run and Skip first.
auto-run-off-title: Each command is shown with Run and Skip first, apart from those you chose Always run for. Click to run every command without asking.
tool-hit-not-shown: not shown to keep the reply short; the model can read the file
reply-context-title: The conversation now takes {{used}} tokens of the model's context, as the server counted this reply's largest request.
reply-context-of-title: The conversation now takes {{used}} of the {{window}} tokens this model is loaded to hold. As it fills, older tool results are trimmed; past full, the oldest turns are folded into a summary.
